readings.text: 歳月若是火多及或印綬雖無財官主吉
readings.consequence: Do not apply a blanket 财官-required verdict to this entire source section.

readings.text: 是見煞取貴然亦不可太多
readings.consequence: 宜 does not establish unconditional success; 太多 threshold unspecified.

readings.text: 提綱建禄將何取須看年時多透露局中六格自分明莫泥提綱反為悮
readings.consequence: Look beyond month to year/hour visibility; no count-based selection.

readings.text: 惟甲丙戊庚壬五陽干有刃乙丁己辛癸五陰干無刃故曰陽刃
readings.consequence: Named five-yang school; not a universal ten-stem table.
Five directly stated coordinates; prediction and adjacent exceptions remain separate.
